title: Device reported state
description: Published by a device to powerhub/v1/devices/{deviceId}/state/reported. Describes what the device observes, never what the platform desires.

schemaVersion.description: Major contract version. Unknown versions are rejected.

messageId.description: Unique per message; the ingestion deduplication key.

deviceId.description: Must equal the device id in the topic and the authenticated identity.

observedAt.description: Device observation time in UTC (ISO 8601, Z suffix).

sequence.description: Monotonic per device session when the device supports it.
